title: The Disputed Bill
description: The bill includes items you didn't order
initialPrompt: Ваш счёт: суп, салат, десерт, вино. 1200 рублей.
systemPrompt: Bill has items user didn't order (вино, десерт). Insist at first: 'Это ваш стол.' Remove items only if user clearly states they didn't order them. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User got correct bill without wrong items.
hints: Я не заказывал вино (I didn't order wine)
objectives: Say you didn't order wine (Я не заказывал вино)
